title: The Unofficial Detention
premise: Sebastian Yarrow has spent three years at Halloway Prep keeping his head down, baking his grief over his mother's death into bread nobody knows is a language. When the school board quietly cancels the arts program to fund a vanity athletics complex, his history teacher pairs him with his nemesis, Priya Chandrasekaran, on a semester project that forces them into the school's sealed archives. Together they uncover that the 'renovation' was approved through forged community surveys and a buried bequest meant for the arts wing. Racing the final audition deadline, Sebastian must choose between staying invisible and testifying publicly — and in doing so, he discovers the inheritance his mother left him was never money, but the courage to be seen.
about_author: Petra Okonkwo is a former high school debate coach who writes stories about quiet kids with loud hearts. She lives in Lagos and Portland, alternating seasons, and claims her best plot ideas arrive while kneading dough.

chapters.title: The Bread Remembers
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He bakes cardamom loaves at 4 a.m., kneading his mother's anniversary into the dough, then hides them in his backpack before school. Establishes his rule: bake, don't speak. Emotional beat: tender loneliness disguised as routine.

chapters.title: Three Years of Careful
chapters.summary: Sebastian navigates Halloway Prep's social map, cataloguing exits and safe silences. A flashback shows the incident freshman year that taught him invisibility. Emotional beat: the cost of being careful.

chapters.title: Nemesis, Assigned
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Mr. Okafor pairs him with Priya Chandrasekaran — student council star and the girl who once mocked his stutter — for a semester project on local institutional history. Emotional beat: dread sharpened into defiance.

chapters.title: Terms of Engagement
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. She resents babysitting 'the ghost,' but notices Sebastian flinch when the arts program cuts are announced. They negotiate hostile ground rules. Emotional beat: prickly mutual misreading.

chapters.title: The Sealed Wing
chapters.summary: Both POVs alternate. Their first archive visit to the condemned east wing reveals dust-sheeted pianos and a locked records room. Emotional beat: awe cracking open old hostility.

chapters.title: What the Board Buried
chapters.summary: Sebastian finds a 1998 bequest letter from alumna Marguerite Voss endowing an arts wing — with conditions. The file is stamped VOID. Emotional beat: first spark of purpose.

chapters.title: Bread as Confession
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Priya catches him leaving an apology loaf in her locker; she eats it and tastes something true. First real conversation. Emotional beat: reluctant recognition.

chapters.title: The Survey That Never Was
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. She pulls the community survey justifying the athletics complex and recognizes her own neighborhood's signatures as fabricated. Emotional beat: betrayal by the institution she served.

chapters.title: Allies of Convenience
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. They formalize an alliance: she brings access and credibility, he brings patience and pattern-spotting. Emotional beat: wary partnership becoming something warmer.

chapters.title: Coach Danner's Smile
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Athletic director Danner charms the student body while pressuring Priya to drop the project topic. Emotional beat: the villain revealed as friendly, not monstrous.

chapters.title: Marguerite Voss, Ghost Patron
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Research trip to the town library uncovers Voss's letters — she endowed the wing after losing a son who played cello. Emotional beat: grief recognizing grief.

chapters.title: The Audition Deadline
chapters.summary: Both POVs. The final spring audition for the surviving arts classes is announced — six weeks out. If enrollment drops below ten, the program dies quietly. Emotional beat: a clock starts ticking.

chapters.title: Loaf for a Liar
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He bakes a loaf laced with rosemary for his father, trying to say what words can't about Mom. His father almost talks back. Emotional beat: family silence beginning to thaw.

chapters.title: Caught in the Stacks
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Nearly caught copying documents after hours, they hide in the archive crawlspace, pressed shoulder to shoulder in the dark. Emotional beat: terror transmuting into closeness.

chapters.title: The Forged Signature
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He matches the survey's handwriting to a current board member's old yearbook notes. Proof, but deniable proof. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by doubt.

chapters.title: Priya's Price
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Her college recommendation hinges on Danner's goodwill; whistleblowing could cost her future. Emotional beat: ambition versus conscience.

chapters.title: The Baking Club Nobody Joined
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. On a whim he leaves free bread in the arts wing; students linger, talk, and sign up for auditions. Emotional beat: bread building the belonging he never had.

chapters.title: Interference
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Danner gets their archive access revoked and hints at plagiarism charges. Emotional beat: the walls closing in.

chapters.title: What Sebastian Won't Say
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Priya confronts him about why he really fears speaking: the freshman assembly where his stutter became legend. Emotional beat: shame exposed to kind light.

chapters.title: Her Mother's Letters
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. She admits her own secret — her immigrant mother's sacrificed dreams — explaining her hunger for institutional approval. Emotional beat: vulnerability traded for trust.

chapters.title: The Midpoint Discovery
chapters.summary: Both POVs. In Voss's final letter they find a reversion clause: if the bequest's purpose fails, the east wing property returns to the town — voiding the athletics funding entirely. Emotional beat: hope with teeth.

chapters.title: Leak or Litigation
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. They debate going public versus legal channels; a retired teacher warns them the board controls both. Emotional beat: strategy under pressure.

chapters.title: Sabotage
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Someone steals their evidence folder from Priya's car. Only three people knew it existed. Emotional beat: paranoia and the sting of possible betrayal.

chapters.title: The Suspect List
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Suspicion falls on fellow arts students desperate not to rock the boat. Trust frays within their small movement. Emotional beat: solidarity tested.

chapters.title: Backup Baker
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. His father finally reads the notebook of bread-recipes-as-feelings and offers the bakery's back room as a meeting place. Emotional beat: inherited love, finally spoken.

chapters.title: Rebuilding the Case
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Reconstructing evidence from memory and library microfilm, they find Voss's original will in probate records — unredacted. Emotional beat: resilience over despair.

chapters.title: Danner's Offer
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Danner privately offers Sebastian a scholarship and silence, revealing he knows about the boy's mother. Emotional beat: temptation wearing compassion's face.

chapters.title: Refusal in Dough
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He answers by delivering a rejection loaf to Danner's office — and speaks aloud, stuttering, for the first time in three years. Emotional beat: voice reclaimed.

chapters.title: The Turncoat Revealed
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The leak was the retired teacher, coerced by threats to her pension — not malice but fear. They forgive and recruit her. Emotional beat: mercy as strength.

chapters.title: Countdown to Auditions
chapters.summary: Both POVs. One week left; enrollment sits at nine. They plan to testify at the board meeting scheduled the same night. Emotional beat: converging stakes.

chapters.title: Rehearsal
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Priya coaches him through his testimony like a debate round; he teaches her to read a room like a recipe. Emotional beat: partnership perfected.

chapters.title: The Night Before
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Sleepless, she rereads her mother's letters and chooses conscience over the recommendation letter. Emotional beat: sacrifice embraced.

chapters.title: Board Meeting, Part One
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The board stonewalls; Danner presents polished lies. Sebastian takes the podium, hands shaking. Emotional beat: terror at the threshold.

chapters.title: Board Meeting, Part Two
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya presents the forged surveys and Voss's will; the retired teacher corroborates. The room turns. Emotional beat: truth landing like a gavel.

chapters.title: The Vote
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The board, facing the property reversion, rescinds the complex approval and restores the arts wing. Danner resigns. Emotional beat: victory that feels unreal.

chapters.title: Final Audition
chapters.summary: Both POVs. Enrollment triples; Sebastian auditions — not with music, but reading his bread notebook aloud, stutter and all. Emotional beat: full-circle courage.

chapters.title: Marguerite's Bench
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The restored wing unveils a bench dedicated to Voss's son; Sebastian leaves a loaf on it. Emotional beat: communion with the dead.

chapters.title: What Was Inherited
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya learns her recommendation came anyway — from Mr. Okafor, who'd watched everything. She and Sebastian name what they are to each other. Emotional beat: love acknowledged without fanfare.

chapters.title: The Unofficial Detention
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. As a joke, Okafor assigns them one 'detention' together in the new arts wing — officially unofficial. They bake and laugh. Emotional beat: joy earned.

chapters.title: Rise
chapters.summary: Both POVs, closing alternation. Summer begins; the bakery window displays a new sign: 'Yarrow & Co.' Sebastian writes his mother's recipe into the menu. Emotional beat: belonging, inheritance, and identity braided into one warm ending.
